key_insight: AI can unify fragmented studies of CsPbX3 instability by linking mechanism discovery, degradation prediction, and engineering strategies into one practical framework.
engineering_relevance: The review highlights AI as a tool to improve stability screening, reliability modeling, and materials design for more durable all-inorganic perovskite devices.
method: Classify and diagnose stability from multimodal experimental and theoretical data
Analyze microscopic degradation mechanisms and coupled failure pathways
Model consequences and guide engineering strategies for stability enhancement
evidence_signal: The abstract emphasizes that current studies are limited by sparse statistics, protocol dependence, multimodal complexity, and weak uncertainty quantification, motivating AI-based approaches.
watch_item: Performance may be unreliable without standardized datasets, consistent testing protocols, and transferable models across domains.
paper_title: Artificial Intelligence for Instability in Inorganic Perovskites: From Mechanism Discovery to Engineering Strategies
